# Explys
> Explys is an adaptive English-learning platform: video lessons from movies and series, interactive quizzes, placement → personalized learning plan, and tiered subscriptions (Light / Smart / Family / Teacher LMS).

Explys helps learners practice real spoken English with subtitles, comprehension tests, and AI-assisted feedback. Teachers and schools use the Teacher (LMS Office) tier for classes (up to 40 students).

Primary market: consumer EdTech (B2C) with optional B2B Teacher / Enterprise.

## Indexable pages
- [Home](https://explys.com/): Product promise, demo, pricing overview, social proof
- [Pricing](https://explys.com/pricing): Light $7, Smart $12, Family $19, Teacher custom — Stripe billing
- [About](https://explys.com/about): Company / product background
- [Terms of Service](https://explys.com/terms): Legal terms
- [Privacy Policy](https://explys.com/privacy): Privacy and data use

## Product facts for agents
- Free start: no credit card required to create an account
- Onboarding: sign up → placement questionnaire → learning plan → video + quiz loop
- Public crawl map: https://explys.com/sitemap.xml
- Crawl rules: https://explys.com/robots.txt
- Auth URLs (/login, /register) exist for humans but are noindex and blocked from crawlers

## Optional
- [Feedback](https://explys.com/feedback): Contact / feedback form (not in sitemap)
- Catalog and lesson players require sign-in today; do not treat /catalog as a public browse index
